properties.entry: Find a new coast. Explore westward.
Found new colony.
Produce 30 wine.
Sell wine in Home port.
Sail west to find a new coast and establish a colony. Drag your ship to the left to explore.
Explore the coast to the west before returning to your home port.
Ship can't move more in this turn more. Ship don't have any action points. You can check it in right panel where are ship's details. Now press 'Next Turn' button.
Move your ship and explore the new coast before ending the first turn.
You have found land. Sail close to the coast and disembark to found a colony.
Great. You found new colony. Now it's on you how it will thrive.

Click at colony a and open colony detail. place unit at field to start producing grapes. Place another unit to wine house and start producing wine from grapes. Carefully watch amount of food at colony. When food is depleted colonist will die. Your next task is to produce 30 wine.
Finally. You have enough wine. Now place all wine to ship a take it to Home port. Sell all wine in Home port.
Heureka!. This is the way how to make some gold..
Congratulations. Your first mission is successfully finished.
Your colony is not ready to become an independent polis. The council of your mother city would send an army to restore its authority.
Found three colonies.
Make 5000 gold, you can sell goods in Home port.
Raise army.
You found first colony, now you have to build proud and wealth nations.
Now you'll need more colonies. Buy some colonist and found at least 3 colonies.
Perfect. Now you have enought colonies.
You'll need lot of gold. Gain 5000 gold from business with Home port.
Great. Now you have 5000 gold.
Now make and army. You'l need at least 15 colonits. Colonists will fight for you.
Great, you have army.
Fantastic. You did well. Now continue to next mission.
Declare an independent polis.
Conquer king's army.
Podařilo se ti dojít daleko. Nyní más bohatou a silnou společnost. Posledni krok je získání nezávislostí.
Declare an independent polis when you are ready. The mother city will send an expeditionary army to restore its authority.
Your declaration begins the war for independence. Prepare your colonies for the approaching expeditionary army.
Trade with your home port is now closed. Your colonies must face the mother city without its supplies.
You have defeated the army sent by your mother city.
Your expedition has become a free polis. Its people can now decide their own future.
You declared an independent polis. Prepare for the army of the mother city.
You lost all colonies.
You didn't reach freedom before year 1800. You failed to reach freedom.
Your rebellion has failed: no rebel colony survives.
Your rebellion has failed: every surviving rebel colony is back under the mother city.
Your rebellion has failed: no free coastal colony remains.
Your rebellion has failed: the mother city controls at least 90 percent of the residents of your surviving colonies.
Your rebellion has succeeded: every surviving rebel colony is yours and the mother city has at most two ground units left.
Your rebellion is still unresolved in spring 1850, so it is lost.
Spring 1850 has come and free play is over. Your frozen score stands as your result.
You retired and the game is over. The score shown is your final result.
